page.overview:
Who is Elwend?

, the King of Faerie, was the fey ruler of Tír Cruthú.

In the past the King of Faerie had influence over the forests.

The Shaper of Life married Elwend and that, combined with her position as a goddess of the woodlands, made her feel like she knew better than druids and followers of the Old Path, who tried to understand and influence nature without her. The souls of dead elves were sent to the Garden of the Spirit, which was in the land of the King of Faerie.
